summary: Unified diff reviewer with dithered add and remove tints and a minimap; accepting or rejecting a hunk dissolves the dropped lines.

attributes.name: labels
attributes.description: The visible and spoken copy, for translation, with the keys `acceptAll`, `allResolved`, `accept`, `reject`, `acceptHunk`, `rejectHunk`, `accepted`, `rejected` and `changesTo`. `{index}` is the one-based hunk number, `{context}` the hunk's context text and `{file}` the file path. Missing keys and invalid JSON use the English defaults. Observed: a change renders the review again.

attributes.name: readonly
attributes.description: Presence attribute. Shows the diff without the hunk buttons and Accept all, and `resolve()` does nothing. Observed: a change renders the review again.

events.name: resolve
events.description: Fires when a hunk is accepted or rejected. `hunk` is its zero-based index. Accept all fires once per open hunk.

methods.description: Accepts or rejects a hunk by index, as its buttons do. Ignored if the hunk is already resolved or does not exist, or the review is read-only.

properties.name: labels
properties.description: The copy in use: the `labels` attribute over the English defaults.

accessibility: The code area is a `role="table"` labelled `Changes to <file>`. Each line is a `row` of four cells (old and new line number, marker, text); each hunk header is a `row` with the header text and its buttons.

Each hunk has native Accept and Reject buttons, named `Accept hunk <n>` and `Reject hunk <n>`. When focus was on a resolved hunk's buttons, it moves to the next open hunk, or to the code area when none is left; Accept all moves it to the code area.
Resolved hunk headers read `✓ Accepted · …` or `✕ Rejected · …`. The added and removed counters are not a live region.
Line tints and the minimap are drawn on an `aria-hidden` canvas; the `+` and `−` markers remain in the text.
motion: With reduced motion, dropped lines disappear at once without the dissolve particles or the collapse, and the counters change without rolling.
notes: Pass a unified diff as the element's text content; without text a built-in sample diff is shown. Changing the text renders the new diff with every hunk open again.

One file per element: the header shows the last `+++` path with `b/` removed, and hunks start at `@@ -a,b +c,d @@` lines. Line numbers count from the hunk headers; `\ No newline at end of file` markers are skipped, and CRLF line endings work.
In React, pass the diff as a string expression such as `{diff}` so line breaks survive; plain JSX text collapses newlines and the diff does not parse.
Accept all accepts every open hunk. The code area scrolls horizontally for long lines; hunk headers with their buttons, the tints and the minimap stay in view.

data.note: Pass your unified diff as the element's text content. Without it a built-in sample diff is shown.
